subject: Re: Demo sprint — sponsor late add and compact session

Cc: Ken Rivera <ken@lynxtech.com>
Date: Tue, 8 Dec 2026 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: Sync — demo next week (possible CTO join)

Hi Soojin,

Thanks again for the intro last month — Ken (our CTO) and I would like to see the latest on the model routing and cost controls before we commit to an internal POC. We booked the slot next Wednesday per the invite, but Ken just told me he may be able to join in person for the last 30 minutes only (he arrives on-site at 10:45am PT).

Can you compress the walkthrough to a tight 45-minute session that ends with the CTO join (so he sees the KPI/latency slides live)? If not, Ken asked whether you can run the full 90-minute demo without him and then capture a 20-minute CT-level debrief just for him.

As a reminder: LynxTech will focus on routing/fallback behavior, Dedicated sizing, and audit logs.

Thanks — Ellen
Ellen Zhang
Head of Product
LynxTech
ellen@lynxtech.com
From: soojin.lee@redwoodai.com
To: Ellen Zhang <ellen@lynxtech.com>
Cc: Ken Rivera <ken@lynxtech.com>, marcus.lin@redwoodai.com, laura.bennett@redwoodai.com
Date: Tue, 8 Dec 2026 11:02:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Sync — demo next week (possible CTO join)

Ellen — really appreciate the heads-up. We can absolutely adapt. Two suggested options:

1) Compact session (preferred): 45 minutes live walkthrough focused on routing, SLA failover, and Dedicated sizing + 10-min Q&A; we record the rest of the deeper tech demo and share a 20-min CT-level summary clip you can show Ken if his slot is tight.

2) Full session + post-demo CTO debrief: run the original 90-min demo; Marcus or I will host a focused 20-min CT briefing off-calendar for Ken the same day.

I'm attaching a proposed compact agenda that trims the architecture walkthrough and prioritizes performance/kpis. If you confirm option 1, we will:
- Cut the architecture deep-dive slides (slides 12–18)
- Surface latency/cost slides up front (slides 5–9)
- Reserve live failover demo and 2 short customer use-cases

Can you confirm which you want by EOD tomorrow? If Ken can arrive a bit earlier (10:30), we can make the compact session end with his arrival window.

Attachments: Redwood_Demo_Agenda_v3.pdf; Proposed-compact-agenda.docx

—
Soojin Lee
Sr. Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwoodai.com | +1 (415) 555-0172
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodai.com>
To: soojin.lee@redwoodai.com, laura.bennett@redwoodai.com
Date: Wed, 9 Dec 2026 08:37:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Sync — demo next week (possible CTO join)

Looping in quick availability: I can take the live routing/failover demo portion and remove the longer kernel/compilation slides — that shaves ~20 minutes. Laura, can you cover the audit/logging and Dedicated sizing Q&A? If we do the compact, I’ll run the short failover live test and then hand to Laura for the last 10.

If they opt for the full session, I’ll still trim two non-critical appendices and then schedule a 20-min CT debrief for late afternoon.

Also recommend we enable the recording and call out the 20-min CT recap as a separate clip we’ll edit and upload the same day.

—Marcus
Staff SWE, Redwood Inference
From: soojin.lee@redwoodai.com
To: Ellen Zhang <ellen@lynxtech.com>, Ken Rivera <ken@lynxtech.com>
Cc: marcus.lin@redwoodai.com, laura.bennett@redwoodai.com
Date: Thu, 10 Dec 2026 10:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Sync — demo next week (possible CTO join)

Ellen — thanks for the quick reply this morning. Option 1 (compact session) works well for our team and keeps Ken in the room for the KPI section. Final plan:

- 45-minute compact demo, focused agenda (see attached compact doc)
- Recording enabled; we will extract a 20-minute CT-level clip and share within 3 hours after the session
- Marcus will lead live routing/failover (first 25 min). Laura will cover Dedicated sizing + audit logs (final 10 min).
- If Ken arrives late, we’ll pause at 35 minutes and do a 10-minute CT recap live once he joins.

I updated the calendar event with two optional 15-minute buffer slots (one before, one after) so we can extend if required. Link: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=abcd1234

Are you happy with this compact flow? If so I’ll lock the agenda and share the recording plan.

—Soojin
From: Ellen Zhang <ellen@lynxtech.com>
To: soojin.lee@redwoodai.com
Cc: Ken Rivera <ken@lynxtech.com>, marcus.lin@redwoodai.com, laura.bennett@redwoodai.com

Subject: Re: Sync — demo next week (possible CTO join)

Perfect — thanks Soojin and team. Ken confirmed he will be able to join from 10:45–11:10. We’ll take the compact 45-minute session and appreciate the CT clip afterwards. One ask: could you capture the live failover demo and the latency/delta slides in the clip (those are Ken’s priorities)? Also if possible, please produce a short set of next-step bullets for procurement (pricing bands, Dedicated commitment options, SOC2 artifacts) in the recap doc so my procurement lead can kick things off.

See you next Wednesday — Ellen
